rows.grounds: compound of cāturya (cleverness), audārya (generosity), dākṣiṇya (courtesy), karaṇa (action), ādi (and-so-forth), guṇa (qualities), and adhika (abounding), describing one endowed with such superior qualities

items.question: What superior qualities further characterize the devoted practitioner being described?
premises: The described figure possesses cleverness as a quality.
The described figure possesses generosity and courtesy.
The described figure abounds in these and other such qualities.
items.inference: The practitioner is distinguished by an abundance of virtues including cleverness, generosity, and courtesy.
uncertainties: The precise sense of karaṇa within the compound list is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: She is abounding in qualities such as cleverness, generosity, courtesy, skillful action, and others.
